candidate.rationale: Third and final candidate, based on all complete captured input, evaluation and review records. Both prior trials used utilization 40, density 0.55, abc_area 0 and repair_margin 0. Candidate 1 enabled both RTL actions: cell area 160081 um2, setup/hold slack -0.0262439/+0.0945523 ns, zero slew/capacitance/fanout violations, failure_classes physical_execution and timing. Candidate 2 disabled isolation and retained width reduction: cell area 161973 um2, setup/hold slack +0.105414/+0.122652 ns, 16 max_slew and 6 max_cap violations, zero max_fanout violations, failure_classes electrical. Both physical_qualified and rank_eligible flags were false for both trials; their energy_j and estimated_power_w maps were empty and measurement_qualified and score were absent. No candidate energy or qualified Q improvement has been established. The reports do not establish the first execution-failure root cause or causally attribute timing changes to isolation. Keep candidate 2 RTL actions and change only repair_margin from 0 to 10, the first positive allowed setting. This is an unseen full configuration/action key. Increased electrical repair margin targets the measured slew/capacitance failure while retaining the latest positive timing slacks. Repair may add buffers or larger cells, increasing cell area, capacitance, energy and timing risk; success is a hypothesis, not a guarantee. Choose 10 rather than the maximum 20 to limit that overhead. Keep placement utilization/density and timing-oriented abc_area 0 because no congestion failure or area-mapping benefit was measured and timing headroom is small. The exact signed 18-bit reduction remains sign extended to 32 bits with unchanged cycle contract. Isolation stays disabled given its unqualified combined trial; width reduction alone has not demonstrated area savings: candidate 2 is 19 um2 above baseline. At candidate 2 area, geometric-mean energy ratio would need to be below 161954/161973 for Q<1; repair overhead makes the required energy reduction larger. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geometric_mean(E_candidate[w]/E_baseline[w]) across DOT64, GEMM8 and CONV3, whose baseline energies are 2.293945631906608e-7, 1.7792685987008622e-6 and 1.1542462882162743e-6 J. Die area is not the objective. Baseline remains the best qualified result with Q=1, area 161954 um2 and setup/hold slack +0.19292/+0.114491 ns at the frozen 10526 ps period. Protected evaluation must report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, per-workload energy_j and estimated_power_w, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, physical_manifest, command outcomes and physical/postprocessing/total wall costs. Compare Q with 1.0 and 0.98 only after physical and workload qualification. Retain all failures and costs: baseline physical/postprocessing/total seconds 3287.496273464989/264.50136737996945/3551.9976408449584; candidate 1 3383.0651913150214/4.2904866859316826e-7/3383.06519174407; candidate 2 4128.303818479995/2.969754859805107e-7/4128.303818776971. Two accepted evaluations are captured, leaving one of three; continue_search is true. Respect the shared 1200-second agent budget with EDA wait separate; cumulative agent usage is not supplied, so remaining agent seconds cannot be certified. Retain the best qualified result even if this proposal fails. Energy scope remains Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route gate activity and extracted SPEF over reset-deassertion-to-settled-completion windows, without SDF-delay/glitch or silicon-power claims. Qualification and Q for this proposal await protected evaluation.
